doc_styles.Keywords: proposal, ruled title, full-width rule, single column, restrained, header-and-total tables
doc_styles.Best For: Single-column proposals whose title block is bounded by a full-width rule and no colour-coded meaning
doc_styles.Not For: slide decks, one-page flyers, marketing collateral
doc_styles.Checklist: headings H1-H3 only;Keep single column;Set a full-width rule directly under the title block;Emphasize by weight and size, not colour;header-and-total rule on tables, no zebra

defaults.Style Bias Terms: narrative structure, formal, persuasive but restrained

designs.Keywords: proposal, research proposal, grant proposal, thesis proposal, serif, centered title, single column, restrained, monochrome
designs.Best For: Research, grant and thesis proposals: a centred serif title block over single-column text in ink -- the most frequent admissible layout in the GitHub proposal corpus, which skews to academic and grant templates (a separate cover page appears in 24 of 39 admissible corpus items; a variant, not fitted)
designs.Not For: commercial sales or consultancy proposals needing a branded cover, slide-style pitch decks, tabular quotes

designs.Keywords: proposal, research proposal, application proposal, sans, centered title, single column, restrained, monochrome
designs.Best For: Research and application proposals wanting a centred sans title block in ink -- second most frequent layout in the GitHub corpus (academic and grant skew) (a separate cover page appears in 24 of 39 admissible corpus items; a variant, not fitted)
designs.Not For: commercial sales or consultancy proposals needing a branded cover, slide-style pitch decks, tabular quotes

designs.Keywords: proposal, project proposal, sans, left-aligned title, single column, restrained, monochrome
designs.Best For: Proposals with a left-aligned sans title block and no colour-coded meaning (academic and grant skew of the GitHub corpus) (a separate cover page appears in 24 of 39 admissible corpus items; a variant, not fitted)
designs.Not For: commercial sales or consultancy proposals needing a branded cover, slide-style pitch decks, tabular quotes

designs.Keywords: proposal, project proposal, serif, ruled title, full-width rule, single column, restrained, monochrome
designs.Best For: Proposals whose serif title block is bounded by a full-width rule (thesis and institute templates; academic skew of the GitHub corpus) (a separate cover page appears in 24 of 39 admissible corpus items; a variant, not fitted)
designs.Not For: commercial sales or consultancy proposals needing a branded cover, slide-style pitch decks, tabular quotes

designs.Keywords: proposal, grant proposal, sans, one accent, centered title, single column
designs.Best For: Proposals with a centred sans title block and one restrained accent colour, as in national-funding application templates (2 corpus items; academic and grant skew) (a separate cover page appears in 24 of 39 admissible corpus items; a variant, not fitted)
designs.Not For: commercial sales or consultancy proposals needing a branded cover, slide-style pitch decks, tabular quotes

designs.Keywords: proposal, project proposal, business proposal, narrative, persuasive
designs.Best For: narrative business and project proposals (commercial and consultancy proposals outside the academic and grant skew of the GitHub corpus; convention only, no ranking evidence)
designs.Not For: slide decks, one-page flyers, tabular quotes
